node.statement: Assume 0<=sigma_g<1. Let G={j:a_j>0 and d_j>tau/4}, B={j:a_j>0 and d_j<=tau/4}, and N={j:a_j<0}. Define q=(p_v-sum_{j in G} a_j^+ p_j)/(1-sigma_g). Equivalently, using p_v=sum_j a_j p_j, q=(sum_{j in B} a_j^+ p_j - sum_{j in N} a_j^- p_j)/(1-sigma_g), and the numerator has total coefficient 1-sigma_g.
